recalls.RECALL_ID: skip: internal campaign identifier — one per row, carries no information beyond the row count
recalls.TOZAR_CD: skip: numeric code for the manufacturer; one-to-one with TOZAR_TEUR, which is shown
recalls.SHNAT_RECALL: chart-years, chart-heat, chart-fix, insight:trend, insight:so_far, insight:software, kpi:last_full
recalls.TEUR_TAKALA: skip: short free-text fault description (~70 chars); its category is SUG_TAKALA, and the full text is in the shell's data explorer
recalls.TKINA_EU: table:cats — 95% of recalls are M1 passenger cars so a chart would be a single bar
recalls.TELEPHONE: skip: importer contact phone — contact detail, not an analytic dimension (available in the data explorer)
recalls.WEBSITE: skip: importer website link — contact detail, not an analytic dimension
